name: Pixasocial
summary: AI suite for social media: audience models, a studio for images, short videos and captions, and posting to 14 networks from one plan without per-channel fees.
best_for: small brands and solo marketers who want to create posts, images and short videos with AI and publish them to many networks from one plan, without paying per channel
skip_if: you only need a scheduler for posts you make elsewhere, want stable, clearly listed limits, or need a long-established vendor with a public track record
honest_knock: The pricing is in flux: the plans, names and amounts had changed between our reads in October and November 2026, and the same page shows euro plan prices next to a "From $49/mo" line in its comparison table. Prices are shown per country with tax added at checkout. Usage on each plan is described as multiples of Start ("4x", "10x") rather than in hard numbers, so it is hard to know in advance when you hit a limit. Premium video, Reel Factory and the bots cost extra.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Start · billed monthly, prices shown in EUR for Germany with tax added at checkout
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-04 on app.pixasocial.com/pricing; prices shown in euros for Germany, tax added at checkout) Pixasocial sells one suite in four sizes. Start costs €29.99 a month, with an opening price of €21.08 a month for the first 3 months, or €299.90 a year on annual billing (€24.99 a month); it includes the audience models, the studio for images, posters and decks, AI image and voice, short hook videos, captions, AI chat and 300 posts a month across 14 networks. Workspace costs €69.99 a month (opening price €52.17 for 3 months) or €699.90 a year, with 4 times the usage and 500 posts a month. Studio costs €99.90 a month with 10 times the usage and 1,000 posts, and Scale €199.90 a month with 25 times the usage and unlimited posts under fair use. A one-off Starter Week of $4.99 for 7 days lets you try the full app without a renewal. Add-ons are billed separately: Reel Factory, which cuts long videos into shorts, from €29.99 a month, and bot plans from $149 a month. The same page also shows "From $49/mo" in its comparison table, and the prices had changed since our earlier read in October, so check the page before you buy.
